59823.subject: Biology
59823.question_text: Explain briefly how a large quantity of dead organic materials dumped into a river can be harmful to aquatic life.
59823.explanation: Dumping of refuse without a commensurate introduction of Oxygen to aid decomposition by aerobes calls for pollution of the river. This is because the carbon (|V) OXIde is increased coupled with the fact that the rate of decomposition is low. Aquatic organisms die as a result of this. The method of addition of  measured quantity of oxygen when a given quantity of refuse is dumped at a given time in a river or sea termed B, O D (Bichemical Oxygen Demand)

59931.subject: Biology
59931.question_text: List three harmful effects of noise pollution.
